# FIKFAP

> FIKFAP is a personalized feed of short porn videos. Swipe, and the feed learns what you like — mainstream or niche, it gets there fast.

Watch at https://fikfap.com. Free, no sign-up needed to start, and it installs to your phone straight from the browser.

## Why people use FIKFAP

- **A feed that gets you.** Stop searching. Watch, swipe, skip — the feed adapts to your taste as you go, and keeps getting sharper.
- **Made for your phone.** Full-screen, vertical, instant playback. Add it to your home screen; there is no app store to go through.
- **Short by design.** Every clip is 60 seconds or less. All of the good part, none of the filler.
- **Free to watch.** No paywall on the feed and no pay-per-video, ever. Ads keep it free.
- **Nothing sleazy.** No fake counters, no bait thumbnails, no tricks to keep you scrolling. Just the videos.
- **Real people who want to be there.** Every Partner is identity-verified before a single clip goes live, so what you are watching is consensual and cleared.

## For Partners

FIKFAP is built to be a good place to post. Verified Partners upload their own short videos, reach an audience that actually wants their niche, and earn from it — with fair terms, numbers you can see, and a team that treats you like a partner, not inventory. Start at https://fikfap.com/partners.

## Good to know

FIKFAP is a pornographic site for adults. You must be 18 or older, and access is age-verified where the law requires it.
